prompt:
Design a desktop website landing screen, 16:9 landscape (1920x1080), rendered as the web page itself edge to edge (no browser window, no device frame, no mockup).

Brand: ROOMi (ROOMiVERSE), a DJ lifestyle brand that delivers gear, space staging and setup so anyone can turn any space into their own party. Use the attached image as the logo: a hand-drawn marker graffiti wordmark "ROOMi".

The site is art-directed as a pop-up venue built inside a shipping container, like Seoul Seongsu-dong container pop-up stores: galvanized steel, raw plywood, banner fabric, gaffer-tape labels, spray paint.

Regions, in order:
1. Top navigation: menu items printed on strips of white gaffer tape stuck across the top. The ROOMi graffiti logo at the exact horizontal center. Left: "Meet ROOMi", "What's Going On", "Let's Party", "Shop". Right: "Cart (0)", "My". Black marker-style small caps on the tape, readable.
2. Full-bleed scene: a container port at night, rows of dark stacked containers in deep black #111111 and blue-black. In the center-right, ONE 40ft container with its doors slightly open, hot pink #F71D64 and violet #C14ED4 party light spilling out through the gap onto wet concrete, a hint of a DJ setup silhouette inside.
3. On that container's doors, the ROOMi logo spray-painted large in white; under it, stenciled container-marking text "RMV 000001 · PARTY ANYWHERE" and a small stenciled arrow with "OPEN" as the entry trigger.
4. Bottom-left: a short line of copy in clean white sans, real reading size: "어디서 누구와 함께하든, 평범한 공간이 파티 공간이 됩니다." with a small peach #FFB792 underline.

One dominant move: the single glowing container. Everything else stays dark and still. No extra cards, no fake prices, no neon tube outlines.
